# Re-Console SMP
![RC-banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/08baf4df9c7009a9faf50483a69aea62697ae75c.webp)

The Re-Console SMP is the official SMP for Re-Console! With an active community, and active staff, you can have an enjoyable time whenever you're craving some LCE like multiplayer.

## Features
- An active staff team, where you can meet and play with the devs of Re-Console and Simply Legacy!
- Claims
- User-ran shops
- Griefing Rollback

## Compatibility
Any vanilla client, or Legacy4J client is compatible with the server! If you'd like to make a custom pack to play, it will work fine here!
